h1: Collection page SEO for broader searches
overview: Collection pages often bring more search visitors than single products, as people search for a type of item before a brand. We improve your category pages with a clear heading, a short helpful introduction, better titles and links to related collections. We also look at filters and sort pages that create duplicate addresses, and set them up so search engines focus on the main page.

faq: How is this different from product page SEO?
Collection pages target broader terms such as running shoes or linen shirts, while product pages target a specific item. They need their own wording and linking, so we handle them separately.
Will extra text make my collection look crowded?
No. We write a short intro above the products and place longer text below, so shoppers still see the products first.
Can you create new collections that search engines like?
Yes at the Premium level. We propose them from keyword data and you approve them. We then build and name them in your store.
They can, depending on the platform. We check how your filters behave and apply the settings your platform allows, so the main collection page stays the one that counts.
